CELEX:62025CJ0327: Judgment of the Court (Ninth Chamber) of 22 October 2026.#„VETS Svoge“ EOOD v Predsedatel na Upravitelnia savet na Fond „Sigurnost na elektroenergiynata sistema“.#Request for a preliminary ruling from the Varhoven administrativen sad.#Reference for a preliminary ruling – Internal market for electricity – Regulation (EU) 2022/1854 – Emergency intervention to address high energy prices – Article 6(1) – Cap on market revenues obtained by producers of electricity using certain energy sources – Article 8 – Earlier national measure – National contribution calculated on the total revenues of electricity producers, levied in order to finance a public entity responsible for ensuring financial stability and the security of the energy market – Measure not coming within the scope of Regulation (EU) 2022/1854 – Directive (EU) 2018/2001 – Promotion of the use of energy from renewable sources – Article 3(1), (3) and (4) – Regulation (EU) 2019/943 – Article 3(a), (b), (h) and (p) and Article 10(1), (4) and (5) – Directive (EU) 2019/944 – Common rules for the internal market for electricity – Article 5(1), (3) and (4) – Regulation (EU) 2021/1119 – European Climate Law – Articles 2 and 4 – Non-discrimination – Proportionality – Article 63 TFEU – Lack of sufficient information – Inadmissibility – Charter of Fundamental Rights of the European Union – No implementation of EU law – No jurisdiction on the part of the Court.#Case C-327/25.

CELEX:62024CJ0840: Judgment of the Court (Fifth Chamber) of 22 October 2026.#Verwertungsgesellschaft Wort (VG Wort) v TL.#Request for a preliminary ruling from the Bundesgerichtshof.#Reference for a preliminary ruling – Copyright and related rights – Directive 2014/26/EU – Collecting society – Article 3(h) – Rights revenue, including compensation for private copying and remuneration for public lending – Article 11(4) – Use of that revenue for purposes other than distribution to rightholders – Funding of social, cultural or educational services – Article 12(4) – Deductions made by the collecting society – Article 13(4) and (6) – Amounts deemed non-distributable – National legislation providing for the promotion of works of cultural importance.#Case C-840/24.
